about: Fixed test vectors for the Cyclone wire format and for cyclonec's schema
fingerprints. Every SDK - Rust, Go, C#, C++ - is expected to reproduce
these exact bytes and these exact digests from the schema in
tests/fixtures/schema/. If an SDK disagrees with this file, the SDK is
wrong; if this file has to change, every SDK changes with it, which is why
it is committed rather than computed.
hex        the payload, as written by the named message's encoder
reencode   the payload the decoder produces when the value it decoded is
encoded again. It differs from `hex` only for the version-skew
vectors, where absent fields come back as zeroes (RFC-0002 9.1).
reject     byte streams that MUST fail, and the error each one is

fingerprint_algorithm.digest: SHA-256 over a canonical UTF-8 text; see SPEC-FINGERPRINT.md
fingerprint_algorithm.u64: the first 8 bytes of the digest, big endian
fingerprint_algorithm.message_id: the first 4 bytes of SHA-256 of 'cyclone-message-id/1\n<name>\n', big endian
fingerprint_algorithm.canonical_example:
cyclone-fingerprint/2
message Player.edge
field 0 id u32
field 1 x f32
field 2 y f32
end

accept.name: player
accept.note: id = 100, x = 10.5, y = 20.0 - little endian, no padding, no tags

accept.name: player-negative-zero
accept.note: -0.0 keeps its sign bit: the bit pattern is written unmodified

accept.name: player-skew-missing-tail
accept.note: an older writer sent two fields; y is absent and reads as zero

accept.name: player-skew-empty
accept.note: every field absent - a valid message of zeroes

accept.name: player-skew-trailing
accept.note: a newer writer appended a field; the extra bytes are ignored

accept.name: device-state-edge
accept.note: id = 42, temperature = 21.5 - display_name belongs to the other codec

accept.name: device-state-unity
accept.note: id = 42, display_name = "sensor-1" - a u32 byte length, then the bytes

accept.name: string-length-counts-bytes
accept.note: "héllo" is 5 characters and 6 bytes; the length is 6

accept.name: every-primitive
accept.hex: 01 fe ff d4fe 901f ffffffff ffffffff feffffffffffffff 0100000000000000 0000803f 0000000000000040 020000006f6b 02000000dead
accept.reencode: 01 fe ff d4fe 901f ffffffff ffffffff feffffffffffffff 0100000000000000 0000803f 0000000000000040 020000006f6b 02000000dead

accept.name: team-nested-and-arrays
accept.note: captain.level = 9, tags = ["a"], scores = [7], roster = [1, 2] - a nested model is inline, an array is a u32 count then its elements

accept.name: team-empty-arrays
accept.note: an empty array is a count of zero, not an absent field

accept.name: team-skew-after-captain
accept.note: the stream ends on a field boundary: the three arrays are absent, and absent is empty

reject.name: truncated-u32
reject.note: the stream ended inside x - a partial field is corruption, never a zero

reject.name: truncated-by-one-byte
reject.note: one byte into y is still inside a field

reject.name: invalid-bool
reject.note: RFC-0002 2.4 - a bool is 0x00 or 0x01, and nothing else is true

reject.name: invalid-utf8
reject.note: a string region that is not valid UTF-8

reject.name: length-past-the-end
reject.note: RFC-0002 10.1 - a length the stream itself cannot satisfy, rejected before allocating

reject.name: array-count-past-the-end
reject.note: two elements promised, one delivered - a count is not version skew
